title: Quick Yeasty Portuguese Pak Choi Skillet
description: A vegan-friendly Portuguese dish featuring pak choi, this recipe is perfect for a solo dinner, with a yeasty and bouncy texture, and can be prepared and cooked quickly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped pak choi and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the yeast, portuguese spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Add the yeast mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the yeast is fragrant and the pak choi is coated.
Serve hot, garnished with additional portuguese spice blend if desired.
